title: presheaf
description: A contravariant functor F : C^op → Set: data F(c) at each object, a restriction map F(f) at each morphism. The representable presheaf Hom(−, A) recovers an object from its incoming arrows (Yoneda). The building block of sheaf theory and of simplicial sets. A functor refined to be contravariant and Set-valued.

contravariant.description: reverses morphisms: a map f : c' → c yields a restriction F(f) : F(c) → F(c')

valued-in.description: the value category — Set for an ordinary presheaf
